description: Jev decision calibration corpus v1 (Phase 3). Hand-labeled state/question/ground-truth triples: choice + noul (judge) + verify (score). Small on purpose; corpus quality determines metric value. Do NOT hand-tune heuristic constants against this file — it is the measuring stick, and tuning to it would invalidate the Brier/ECE numbers. Heuristic backend is the miscalibrated control: expect visibly poor calibration; that IS the point.
